title: Government job, private job or freelance by type
caption:
Sarkari naukri, private job or freelancing: the great Pakistani family debate.

The truth? Your type has a lot to say about where you'll thrive. Some love clear rules and a steady ladder. Some need targets and speed. Some do their best work alone, at odd hours, for clients across the world. And many mix two.

Which one are you in right now, and which one do you want?
